doNow: Do NOT induce vomiting unless explicitly instructed by a veterinarian or poison helpline.
Collect the packaging, wrapper, or plant sample to identify chemical contents.
Call (888) 426-4435 immediately while traveling to the nearest emergency clinic.

firstAidGuides.condition: Acute Heatstroke (Heavy Panting, Glazed Eyes, Vomiting)
doNow: Move pet immediately into shade or air conditioning.
Apply cool (never ice-cold) tap water to paws, groin, and neck.
Offer small sips of cool water; never force drinking.
Transport to ER clinic with vehicle AC on high.
Apply firm, direct pressure over the wound using a clean gauze or cotton cloth.
Maintain continuous pressure for at least 3-5 minutes without lifting the pad.
Keep the animal warm with a light blanket to combat circulatory shock.
Carefully open the mouth to check if an object is visible; swipe only if loose to avoid pushing it deeper.
For small pets: hold upside down by thighs with gentle back slaps.
For large pets: perform canine Heimlich by standing behind them and pressing upward behind the ribcage.
